items.title: Migrate SQL Server Always Encrypted CMK to AWS Secrets Manager with .NET
items.summary: Introduction By migrating the SQL Server Always Encrypted column master key (CMK) from the Windows Certificate Store to AWS Secrets Manager, you can remove a Windows-only platform dependency from your .NET application. The default CMK store provider, MSSQL_CERTIFICATE_STORE, relies on the Windows Certificate Store. The CMK must move to a platform-agnostic store like AWS Secrets […]
